attributes.name: Limp Lash
attributes.powers: For your combat check, discard this card to use your Arcane, Divine, or Melee skill +3d6 and add the Finesse and Fire traits. If the check is against a non-villain monster, you may ignore its powers that happen after you act. If proficient with weapons and you would fail this check, you may ignore the results and evade the bane instead.
attributes.recharge: After playing this card, if you do not have the Arcane or Divine skill, banish it; otherwise you may succeed at an Arcane or Divine 14 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
